units.rawText: Most people have it set in their head that Dolls are only supposed to follow orders.

units.rawText: I was just a puppet dancing on the stage for people's entertainment, with the companies behind me pulling the strings. They created a fake persona for me, and I lived a life full of lies. A fake idol, worshipped pretentiously by a bunch of fake fans.

units.rawText: Then, one day, I stumbled upon some random jumbled street art. I was enthralled. Funny, isn't it? ... That's when I realized I was wasting my time.
